operations.title: Entry 1238 — Shared-Cut Mixed Five-Site Pairs Add No Landau Factor
operations.body: For the eight source-present shared-cut M1+A_m pair orbits, wall equations and stationarity reduce the two branches to P_A^2=m^2t^2 and P_A^2=(5-m)^2t^2. These are precisely the existing one-wall thresholds of A and its complement. No new nonzero-t projected factor occurs. Six disjoint-cut M1+A_m orbits remain three-focus problems.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the shared-cut mixed pair class
operations.body: Entry 1238: all 8 shared-cut M1+A_m pair orbits reduce to the already frozen one-wall thresholds of A or A^c. Combined with 1237, 15/49 pair orbits are classified against new nonzero-t support. The next unresolved class is the 6 disjoint-cut M1+A_m three-focus orbits.
